generation.scope: For ordinary slopes the signed discriminant double solid has sixteen ordinary double points. Over invertible first matrices its projective paired-root graph is a small resolution with eight exceptional lines of normal bundle O(-1) twice; the companion embeds each in the opposite contact conic. Reversing the sign interchanges the two local small resolutions.

proof_review.scope: Verified the local rank-one matrix model, proper quasi-finite descent to the normal small resolution, normal bundles, and transpose flop.

mathematical_computation.scope: Checked both local-coordinate Jacobians, all eight bilinear graph determinants, all contact-plane and discriminant identities, and base-point-free degree-two embeddings.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Determine whether the two-position exchange has fixed points on the resolved Kummer family, and use the exceptional slopes or the residual complement to refine the regularity test.
